content:
Ellison Park: Hey team — first day here! Quick intro: I’m Ellison (product infra), based in PDX. Quick Q: I accepted the MDM invite but no device shows up yet. Also where do I find the team runbooks and who do I ping for badge/laptop pickup? Fun fact: I keep a sourdough starter named 'Biscuit' :tada:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome, Ellison! 🎉 Please complete the onboarding checklist at https://redwood.internal/onboard/2723456789. MDM emails are typically from it-support@redwood; if not received within 24h, reply here and we'll escalate. Badge requests are handled via the facilities form (link in checklist).
Tara Nguyen: hi ellison — welcome!! :wave: I’m your onboarding buddy. I’ll nudge facilities and IT. For MDM, sometimes the invite email gets hidden; check spam or try opening the link in an incognito window. I’ll DM you to coordinate badge pickup time.
Maya Li: welcome!! runbooks live in Confluence -> Team Docs -> infra-runbooks. Start with "workstation-setup" and "vpn-onboarding". If you need access to any repos, mention me or @devops and we’ll add you.
Ben Wu: pinged infra to speed up MDM. If/when you get the laptop and want to test SSH, use: `ssh ellison@jump.redwood.internal` (you’ll get your SSH key via the onboarding flow). We standardize on the Nix dev shell but there’s a Docker fallback in the runbook. Coffee preference? :coffee:
Devon Ortiz: welcome ellison — also a sourdough person here. If you want a starter swap or cast-iron pan for day one cooking, I’ve got extras. Also fwiw, Slack channel `#eng-runtime` is the best place for low-latency infra questions.
Ellison Park: awesome, thanks everyone — I can see the Slack invite now and filled the checklist. DMing Tara about pickup. Coffee: black no sugar. Appreciate the cast-iron offer, Devon :)
Tara Nguyen: got your DM, will coordinate. Also added you to `#eng-runtime` and `#new-hires` channels. If anything blocks, drop it here and I’ll chase IT.
Onboarding-Bot: Facilities ticket #FAC-4987 created for badge pickup. IT ticket #IT-9021 created to check MDM status. You’ll get updates in this thread when they change.
Ben Wu: welcome aboard again — excited to have you. If you want to pair on the first-day dev-env setup, ping me and we’ll hop on a quick call.
Ellison Park: thanks Ben — will take you up on that later today.
Maya Li: also — tiny welcome ritual: share a GIF or a photo of your home office in `#random` when you’re settled :grin:
